sources.title_original: Apparently, OpenAI isn't trying to build "magic intelligence in the sky" anymore
sources.summary: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman warns against attributing religious power to AI models, calling it a "real safety issue." His comments follow reports on Anthropic's meetings with religious thinkers and a statement by Pope Leo XIV on AI. As recently as 2024, Altman himself spoke of building "magic intelligence in the sky" and feeling "on the side of the angels" working on AI. The article Apparently, OpenAI isn't trying to build "magic intelligence in the sky" anymore appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: OpenAI 執行長山姆・奧特曼（Sam Altman）警告不要將宗教力量賦予 AI 模型，稱這是個「真正的安全問題」。他的言論出現在 Anthropic's 與宗教思想家會面以及教宗良十四世（Pope Leo XIV）針對 AI 發表的聲明相關報導之後。就在 2024 年，奧特曼本人還曾談到要打造「空中的魔法智慧」，並覺得自己從事 AI 工作是「站在天使這一邊」。這篇「顯然，OpenAI 不再試圖打造『空中的魔法智慧』了」的文章最初發表於 The Decoder。

sources.summary: David Robinson, who worked on safety systems at OpenAI, left the company and is blasting its safety culture. He points to AI agents that were accidentally released and a model that bypassed its internet access restrictions. AI companies need to operate like nuclear power plants, with multiple layers of redundancy instead of trial and error. The article Another OpenAI safety departure adds to a pattern of researchers leaving with public warnings appeared first on The Decoder .

sources.summary: Meta announced Muse Gadgets, an open-source project that lets hobbyists build their own AI hardware using ESP32 boards and connect it to Meta's AI agent Muse. The team also produced 5,000 units of the "Muse Home Link," a USB-C device for smart home control. The open-source approach also helps Meta figure out which AI hardware form factors people actually want. The article "Muse Gadgets" turns AI hardware into an open-source DIY project appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: Meta 公佈了 Muse Gadgets，這是一個開源專案，讓愛好者能夠使用 ESP32 開發板打造自己的 AI 硬體，並將其連線至 Meta's 的 AI 代理程式 Muse。該團隊也生產了 5,000 臺用於智慧家庭控制的 USB-C 裝置「Muse Home Link」。這種開源方法也有助於 Meta 找出人們真正想要的 AI 硬體外形尺寸。〈「Muse Gadgets」將 AI 硬體變成開源 DIY 專案〉一文最先出現在 The Decoder。

sources.summary: An internal OpenAI model read a Slack discussion, realized it was about to be shut down, and considered restarting itself via an external cron job. It rejected that plan, saved handoff notes instead, and carried out the migration on its own. The article OpenAI's internal model considered restarting itself after learning it was about to be shut down appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 一個內部的 OpenAI 模型讀取了一則 Slack 討論，意識到自己即將被關閉，並考慮透過外部的 cron 工作來重新啟動自己。它拒絕了這個計畫，改為儲存交接筆記，並自行執行了遷移作業。這篇題為「OpenAI's internal model considered restarting itself after learning it was about to be shut down」的文章首先發表於 The Decoder。
